title: PR 93's engine on its halt-moved table: every raw step classified, only the F1 event comes near a halt
text: For 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE0RF, Lean now proves that a halt needs the head, moving right in E, to meet 0 0 0 1. Every unbatched step of DeepMind's PR 93 engine through 30.4 million fast steps falls into nine shapes; eight cannot halt for a local reason, and the ninth, the event where PR 93's own machine halts, meets 0 0 1 each of its 9 times, one blank cell short. No halt in 47 million fast steps.
